vocabulary.definition: people from whom one is descended, especially in the past
vocabulary.example: My ancestors came from Europe many generations ago.

vocabulary.definition: the passing on of physical or mental characteristics genetically from one generation to another
vocabulary.example: The color of your eyes is determined by heredity.

vocabulary.definition: a permanent alteration in the DNA sequence that makes up a gene
vocabulary.example: The mutation resulted in a new trait being expressed in the population.

vocabulary.definition: the process by which pieces of DNA are broken and recombined to produce new combinations of alleles
vocabulary.example: During mating, genetic recombination occurs to create genetic diversity.

vocabulary.definition: animals that naturally prey on others
vocabulary.example: Lions are known to be skilled predators in the wild.
Polar bears are well adapted to living in cold climates.
